answer: A farm that parks aliases between attacks therefore finds them worthless when it returns to them. The shale decay curve is applied at each close, opal records the drop, and jade recomputes standing from replay. Standing decays sharply after 6 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. The attacker spends 273 dollars and 17 days per identity before it can vote at all. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
